enter_modbus_info.title: Modbus Connection
enter_modbus_info.description: Enter the IP address and port of your Elfin EW11A or Modbus TCP gateway

cop_method_description.direct_thermal: Direct thermal calculation using water flow and temperature difference (±5% accuracy)
cop_method_description.power_module: Power module estimation using internal sensors and external validation (±8% accuracy)
cop_method_description.power_estimation: Power consumption estimation using compressor and fan data (±10% accuracy)
cop_method_description.refrigerant_circuit: Refrigerant circuit analysis using pressure and temperature sensors (±12% accuracy)
cop_method_description.carnot_estimation: Carnot-based estimation using compressor frequency and ambient temperature (±15% accuracy)
cop_method_description.valve_correlation: Valve position correlation using expansion valve data (±20% accuracy)
cop_method_description.temperature_difference: Temperature difference estimation using empirical relationships (±30% accuracy)
cop_method_description.insufficient_data: Insufficient data available for any COP calculation method

adaptive_control.indoor_unchanged_warn: The indoor temperature has been the same value for 12 hours. Check the sensor and the flow that sends it.
adaptive_control.indoor_unchanged_stale: The indoor temperature has not changed for 24 hours. The adaptive control no longer corrects on it and the building model has stopped learning, until a different value arrives.
adaptive_control.indoor_changed_again: The indoor temperature is changing again. The adaptive control and the building model use it again.

errors.zone_onoff_disabled: On/off via zone control register 2101 is experimental. Enable 'On/off via zone control (experimental)' in the device settings to use it.
errors.silent_level2_r290_only: Silent mode level 2 is only available on R290 heat pumps.
errors.adaptive_setpoint_range: The maximum water temperature must be at least __gap__°C above the minimum water temperature.
errors.diy_curve_not_read: The DIY heating curve (L28/L29) has not been read yet. Try again in a minute.
errors.diy_curve_unusable: The DIY heating curve (L28/L29) cannot be used: the slope L28 is not negative, or the values fall outside the app curve (20–65 °C at −15 °C, 15–50 °C at +15 °C).

live_operation.load_failed: Live data could not be loaded.

modbusRegisterDescriptions.sterilization_start_hour: Start hour 0..23 (23 = 23:00), observed on program 433 / protocol 143. Older specification used HHMM 2300.
modbusRegisterDescriptions.suspected_custom_curve_point: Suspected custom heating curve point c{point}
modbusRegisterDescriptions.suspected_custom_curve_point_description: Suspected coordinate c{point} of the custom heating curve. The outdoor temperature at this point and its relationship to L28/L29 have not been confirmed.
modbusRegisterDescriptions.heat_pump_clock_description: Heat pump clock: value = hour × 256 + minute. High byte = hour, low byte = minute; 0x1523 = 21:35 (decimal 5411). Based on observed behaviour; the OEM table lists this address as reserved. Read only.
modbusRegisterDescriptions.unknown_control_register_description: The meaning of this register has not been established. Read-only for investigation.
modbusRegisterDescriptions.suspected_curve_slope_description: Suspected slope coefficient of an additional heating curve, paired with {partner}. Purpose, scale and formula are unconfirmed; the register value remains raw.
modbusRegisterDescriptions.suspected_curve_constant_description: Suspected constant of an additional heating curve, paired with {partner}. Purpose, unit and formula are unconfirmed.
modbusRegisterDescriptions.suspected_hour_setting_description: The measured range 0..23 fits an hour setting. Start/end roles and the relationship to heating curves are unconfirmed.
modbusRegisterDescriptions.binary_parameter_description: The measured range 0..1 fits a switch or flag. The meaning of 0 and 1 and the relationship to heating curves are unconfirmed.

modbusParameterBanks.empty: No P or L parameters in this selection.
modbusParameterBanks.complete: {available} bank ranges available; {fallback} using app definitions.
modbusParameterBanks.stopped: Stopped fetching: no usable bank data received.
modbusParameterBanks.error: Parameter limits could not be fetched.
modbusParameterBanks.unreadHelp: Read the min/max blocks or click Fetch parameter limits.
modbusParameterBanks.readOnly: This parameter limit bank is read-only.
modbusParameterBanks.unconfirmedPositionHelp: Diagnostic bank position L61–L74. The recorded dump has limits 0..0 and corresponding flag bits 0; a parameter function is unconfirmed.
